prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Pearland, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1198; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but you can reference the claim file.
Q: Understood. Can you describe where the accident happened?
A: It was on a multi-lane road in Pearland, Texas, around the middle of the afternoon. I was in the right lane and wanted to move over to the left lane because of a slow vehicle ahead.
Q: What did you do before changing lanes?
A: I checked my mirror and glanced over my shoulder. I saw a gap and started to move over, signaling the whole time.
Q: What happened next?
A: A vehicle in the left lane came up fast and sideswiped the passenger side of my car. There was a loud scrape and my car pushed toward the shoulder.
Q: Did you stop after the impact?
A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder as soon as I could control the steering. The other driver stopped a short distance ahead.
Q: Did you feel any injuries at the scene?
A: My neck felt stiff, but I thought it would pass. By the next morning I had sharp pain in my neck and upper back, and I had headaches.
Q: Have you seen a doctor for these symptoms?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care and then saw my primary care physician. They diagnosed whiplash and gave me a treatment plan.
Q: Are you currently receiving treatment?
A: I'm going to physical therapy twice a week and taking prescribed pain medication. Some days I still have trouble turning my head while driving.
Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I was following the traffic laws and signaling when the collision happened.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
